data.title: Olfah
data.about:
Olfah by Alef Group in Sharjah is an exclusive enclave of premium one, two, and three bedroom apartments designed to redefine modern living. This Muweilah residential project spans 12 architectural buildings, seamlessly blending urban sophistication with natural beauty. Surrounded by 26,000 square meters of green spaces, Olfah by Alef Group offers an escape into relaxation and comfort with ample outdoor amenities.

The Olfah community at Muwaileh Commercial is entirely walkable, promoting a sustainable, car-free lifestyle. Proximity to Sharjah’s key landmarks, including the University City and Sharjah Mosque, makes Olfah by Alef Group a prime choice for convenience and connectivity.

Thoughtfully crafted apartments at Olfah by Alef feature expansive windows that welcome abundant natural light. Amenities like lush lawn hills, outdoor gyms, and scenic woodland walks create a vibrant, health-focused community. Olfah’s balance of modernity and nature offers a serene retreat for residents seeking a refined lifestyle in Sharjah.

characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
•  Eco-Friendly Community: Olfah by Alef Group in Sharjah offers an entirely walkable, car-free environment, promoting sustainable urban living with abundant green spaces.
  • Prime Connectivity: Strategically located at Muwaileh Commercial, Olfah ensures seamless access to Sharjah's landmarks and major roads and convenient connectivity to Dubai.
  • Thoughtfully Designed Residences: Each apartment features premium finishes, ample natural light, and spacious layouts, combining luxury with a serene ambiance in Sharjah’s latest Muweilah residential project.
  • Extensive Amenities: Olfah by Alef Group at Muweilah provides recreational areas like outdoor gyms, woodland walks, and children’s play zones, catering to varied lifestyle needs.
  • Enhanced Lifestyle Experience: Positioned to balance urban sophistication and nature, Olfah’s master plan offers residents an enriching, wellness-focused community experience.

location_tile.title: Where Urban Convenience Meets Serene Living in the Heart of Sharjah
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Olfah by Alef Group in Sharjah offers a prime location at Muweilah along Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Al Nahyan Road. This Muweilah residential project ensures seamless connectivity across Sharjah and beyond, with quick access to major roads like Maleha Street. Just a short drive from Dubai International Airport, Olfah by Alef Group location places residents near Sharjah's key landmarks, including the Sharjah Mosque, and top educational and career opportunities, all within a calm, thoughtfully designed community.

05 Minutes to Sharjah Airport
02 Minutes to the University City of Sharjah
05 Minutes to 06 Mall
10 Minutes to Sharjah International Airport
15 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
25 Minutes to Downtown Dubai

seo.metaDescription: Discover Olfah by Alef Group in Sharjah, a vibrant Muweilah residential project offering modern apartments. Enjoy the thoughtfully designed prime living.

more_info.answer: Olfah by Alef Group offers a car-free, walkable community with lush green spaces, premium amenities, and seamless connectivity to Sharjah’s major destinations.
more_info.question: What makes Olfah by Alef Group at Muweilah unique among Sharjah's residential projects?

more_info.answer: Olfah is located in Muweilah along Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Al Nahyan Road, near Sharjah Mosque and the University City. It is also within a short drive of Dubai.
more_info.question: Where is Olfah by Alef Group located, and what landmarks are nearby?

more_info.answer: Olfah offers one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed for comfort and style. They feature high-quality finishes, ample natural light, and views of green spaces.
more_info.question: What types of apartments are available in Olfah by Alef Group in Sharjah?

more_info.answer: Yes, Olfah includes family-friendly amenities such as kids' play areas, jogging tracks, woodland walks, and outdoor gyms, making it ideal for residents of all ages.
more_info.question: Does Olfah by Alef Group feature any family-friendly amenities?

more_info.answer: The Olfah master plan features an entirely walkable, car-free environment, green spaces, and recreational areas, encouraging a healthier, nature-focused lifestyle.
